history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the Management Client Board continues to prioritize the development of policies in the Organization and reviews the progression of such work on a regular basis, with the aim of expediting their promulgation.
history.administration_response: The Management Client Board is regularly consulted on policy development priorities as and when they advance to a point where consultation with the Board is called for as part of the wider organizational consultation process. Consultation on policy development is a standing agenda item for the consideration of the Management Client Board, as linked to ongoing activities and as explained above. The Management Client Board also holds annual consultations on matters related to policy priorities. The most recent annual discussion took place on 27 March 2023. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
